ownership: All server descendants, same-user Docker backends/controllers, and exactly one VM service whose open backing store matches Docker's vms/0/data/Docker.raw. No other active containers beyond this run's observer and its database-bound job/fence names. No unrelated model inference.
method: Native footprint JSON in byte units with category/shared-mapping/charged-ledger data. Report observed maxima of native de-duplicated dirty, clean and reclaimable categories. Swapped and wired are subsets; guest/container memory is nested and never added. GPU/IOKit/unmapped/nofootprint categories are retained where returned. System auxiliary footprint is logical charged dirty memory, can exceed physical RAM, and stays separate.
limits: Includes all Docker guest/kernel/cache/observer overhead, not incremental app-only cost. Global shared OS cache, unattributed system drivers, other-user services and browser are excluded. Samples are inspection windows, not atomic machine snapshots or continuous peaks. A sampled twelve-GiB budget is diagnostic, not an OS-enforced whole-application cap.
host_workloads: Apple M1 16 GiB reference host; ordinary interactive/background applications remain. Same-user Docker VM/backends included with backing-store proof; reject other active containers and unrelated inference. Native footprint group queries at 0.5 s plus existing component/guest observers are part of workflow overhead. No tests, builds, browser verification, upgrades, downloads or unrelated inference during measurements; OS/Docker caches retained.
